requirement: 只读核对 Tokage 普通主会话上下文建议、保留信息发送和 CONTEXT 首轮反事实账本的生产调用链与测试覆盖，给出可复核的缺口清单。上一轮部分源码未附加，本次通过正常编辑器和输入框提供完整、去重的实际源文件及测试；这是人工辅助材料传递，不作为模型自主读文件的证据。
scope: Main-session suggest -> explicit adoption -> real next-turn fresh-window carrier -> CONTEXT settlement, plus ordinary large-message transport; no M2/M3 implementation or test-only runtime behavior.
sequence: First ordinary brief request establishes a bounded session goal.
Second user request supplies the full context production-chain corpus and corresponding tests/docs, each file once. Ask for concise findings, no repeated source.
If useful, a third source/test review covers omitted IPC/environment/contract regressions. No text padding or repeated paid probing.

When normal UI offers COMPACT and permits it, explicitly queue then send the next useful review question as carrier. FRESH-only or unavailable actions remain unverified; do not enable unsupported execution.
nonGoals: No changed costs, model windows, thresholds or cooldown to force the gate

limits.stop: Stop on auth/model error, unexpected provider, missing cost on completed turn, persistent UI failure, two failures with same cause, or limit. If no actionable recommendation, preserve unverified status.

build: Committed independent clone; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 npm run tauri -- build --bundles app --config ../tauri-isolation.json
environment: Same Mac; CLI HOME shared; App data isolated; ephemeral WebView; warm npm/Cargo caches. Release target copied via APFS clone from prior external candidate; no cold-build or frontend persistence claims. No special runtime env or permissions.
acceptance: Normal UI offers action and queues only after explicit click
Carrier expanded retained context matches the actual request observed via its task-owned temporary message file
Completed carrier has a new Aider native thread and reports real USD cost
Read-only consistent DB backup links action and savings event, basis=first_turn_counterfactual_v1, horizonTurns=1, baseline and observed cost match; compare dashboard display
checks: Native 434 unit + 1 integration passed, 34 ignored; targeted final replay passed; isolation and diff checks passed.
